blocking_findings.title: Final evidence-read failures can still return a positive owner candidate and RC0

locations.role: Records stream_read_errors / available_evidence_errors; absent final available reports become None.
complete_candidate ignores those final evidence fields.
Final rc can remain0 when complete_candidate is true and receipt write succeeds.

blocking_findings.static_failure_path: After normal reports, raw0, deliberate reap, group absence and empty stream check succeed, a final rec(adapter.stdout) or rec(adapter.stderr) can fail at370. The exception is saved under stream_read_errors371 without changing normal, failure, cleanup_errors or all_controls_unchanged. Line385 can still set complete_candidate=true; line409 can return0. The same omission applies to errors at374-375. This is source reasoning, not an injected or executed test.
blocking_findings.why_blocking: The source promises complete final streams/evidence and refusal on read failures. A success-shaped candidate/RC0 despite an explicitly retained final evidence error weakens that gate. Separate root accounting may still reject it; that later safeguard does not make this owner completion path error-free.
blocking_findings.smallest_correction_direction: In a fresh immutable successor, make every final stream/evidence read error and unexpected missing required descriptor refuse the owner candidate/RC. Route them into an existing failure gate or explicitly require empty error lists plus required final stream/helper descriptors. Preserve the failed001 packet and its exact diff/reuse records. Add later source guards for each failing final rec() and missing-evidence branch; do not run them under this review.

unexecuted_source_guard_followups: final stream rec failure with otherwise positive normal state must return refused
available adapter/helper rec failure or unexpected missing final evidence must return refused
final evidence errors must remain recorded after refusal; no synthetic helper fields
receipt flush/close/cap/late errors and unreaped last-resort exit remain refused
